option_relations.rationale: The vignette describes a traumatic injury to the cervical spine with resulting quadriplegia and spinal cord compression, which is a subtype of traumatic spinal cord injury.
The option describes a cervical spinal cord injury with spinal cord compression, which is a specific instance of traumatic spinal cord injury.
The option describes a traumatic spinal cord injury with spinal cord compression and anterolisthesis, which is a subtype of traumatic spinal cord injury.
The option describes a complete spinal cord injury at the C4-C5 level with intramedullary hemorrhage, which is a specific instance of traumatic spinal cord injury.
